title_zh: 靠纸条借伞的对门邻居
title_en: Funny Stories from Life (11/20): The Neighbor Across the Hall Who Lent Umbrellas by Note
note_en: When 才 comes after a time or event, it means something happened later than expected, "only then": 两人同时开门，才第一次看清彼此的脸 "they opened their doors at the same time, and only then did they see each other's faces for the first time." English often needs "only then" or "not until" plus inverted word order; Chinese just slips 才 in before the verb.
